name: Naze ka?! Sweet Home
original_name: なぜか?! すぃ～とほ～む
source:
The protagonist, Kazuya, is sent to live with his married older brother Tatsuya to better focus on his exams. Not wanting to impose on the lovey-dovey couple, Kazuya refuses at first, but Tatsuya is very keen on the idea, so Kazuya eventually agrees.

However, Tatsuya is busy at work and often comes home late, if at all, leaving the younger Kazuya alone with his sister-in-law Minami most of the time.

Seeing Minami around the house constantly in various compromising situations, Kazuya has trouble concentrating on his studies. As you can imagine, he succumbs to the temptation… but this, too, is all part of his brother's grand plan! Tatsuya, who loves to dote on his little brother, just wants Kazuya to gain some solid experience(?) with a woman before heading out into the real world.

Just as Kazuya's "big bro-approved"(?!) relationship with Minami begins to bloom, Miyuki—Minami's mom—turns up at the house. Faced with the even more defenseless and debauched Miyuki, Kazuya cannot begin to hide his confusion at which of them he prefers. It doesn't take long for the easily swayed Kazuya to start sleeping with Miyuki, too.

To complicate things further, Aunt Kasumi, only daughter of the Fujiwaras, is next to arrive at the harem home of the Yoshiwara brothers. Tatsuya harbors deep distrust towards the Fujiwaras ever since they attempted to take guardianship of Kazuya, and is soon fighting with her like cats and dogs.

So what is Kasumi scheming exactly...? And what does the future have in store for our protagonist, thrown into this exhausting predicament at a crucial time in his life?! Harem problems can be tough...

translation:
主人公吉原和也为专心备考，被送去与已婚的哥哥吉原达也同住。不想打扰恩爱的哥哥和嫂子吉原南，和也起初拒绝了；但达也非常希望他来，和也最终答应。

然而，达也工作繁忙，即使回家也常常很晚，这让和也大部分时间都与嫂子南独处。

看着南在家中不断处于各种令人遐想的姿态，和也很难专心学习。如你所料，他屈服于诱惑……但这也是哥哥宏大计划的一部分！达也宠爱弟弟，只是想让和也在踏入社会前，与女性积累些扎实的经验（？）。

就在和也这段获得“哥哥批准”（？！）的关系与南开始发展时，南的母亲原田美雪来到家中。面对更加毫无防备、放荡的美雪，和也完全无法掩饰自己更喜欢哪一个的困惑。没过多久，容易动摇的和也也开始和美雪上床。

让事情更复杂的是，藤原家的独女霞阿姨随后来到吉原兄弟这座后宫般的家。达也自藤原家试图取得和也监护权后，便对他们深感不信任，很快便与霞像猫狗般争吵起来。

霞究竟在策划什么……？而在生命关键时期被抛入这场令人疲惫困境的主人公，未来又将如何？！后宫问题可真棘手……
